description: This file defines interfaces related to encoding and decoding fields within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes marker interfaces, generic interfaces for specific types, and callbacks for serialization lifecycle events. The file establishes the structure for field codecs used in serialization processes.

classes.name: UntypedCodecWrapper<TField>
classes.description: A wrapper that allows using an IFieldCodec with a specific field type, providing type conversion at runtime.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Encodes a field value for serialization, with an explicit expected type.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Decodes and returns a field value from the serialization stream.
